automatons.title: Automatons
automatons.description: The Automatons are a machine faction hostile to Super Earth. They field heavily armored infantry, walkers, tanks, industrial war machines, and large-scale invasion forces across the Galactic War.

terminids.title: Terminids
terminids.description: The Terminids are a rapidly reproducing insectoid species that have repeatedly threatened Super Earth-controlled worlds. They are also closely tied to the production of Element 710.

illuminate.title: Illuminate
illuminate.description: The Illuminate are an advanced alien civilization known for highly sophisticated technology, energy weapons, teleportation, and other abilities far beyond ordinary human technology.

super-earth.title: Super Earth
super-earth.description: Super Earth is the center of the Federation and the governing power behind the Helldivers, SEAF, and humanity's expansion throughout the galaxy.

managed-democracy.title: Managed Democracy
managed-democracy.description: Managed Democracy is Super Earth's computerized voting system. Citizens answer questions and an algorithm determines which candidates best represent their choices, which Super Earth presents as eliminating the uncertainty of older democratic systems.

cyborgs.title: Cyborgs
cyborgs.description: The Cyborgs originated as former Super Earth citizens who attempted to secede from the Federation. After their defeat, they were forced into labor on Cyberstan. Their history is closely connected to the later rise of the Automatons.

malevelon-creek.title: Malevelon Creek
malevelon-creek.description: Malevelon Creek is an ionic jungle world in the Severin Sector that became one of the most famous battlefields of the Second Galactic War. Early in the war, Helldivers repeatedly fought Automaton forces there despite difficult conditions and limited support.

meridia.title: Meridia
meridia.description: Meridia became a Terminid Supercolony after some Terminids adapted to the Termicide used by Super Earth. The planet was eventually destroyed using Dark Fluid, collapsing it into the Meridian Black Hole.

helldivers.title: Helldivers
helldivers.description: Helldivers are elite soldiers deployed by Super Earth to conduct high-risk missions across hostile worlds. They are launched from orbit aboard Super Destroyers and are expected to complete objectives under extreme battlefield conditions in service of Managed Democracy.

seaf.title: Super Earth Armed Forces (SEAF)
seaf.description: The Super Earth Armed Forces, commonly known as SEAF, are the conventional military forces of Super Earth. They defend Federation territory, operate military installations, and fight alongside the Helldivers throughout the Galactic War.

super-destroyer.title: Super Destroyer
super-destroyer.description: The Super Destroyer is the orbital warship assigned to a Helldiver. It serves as a mobile command center and provides orbital support, equipment deployment, reinforcements, and transportation between operations.

pelican-1.title: Pelican-1
pelican-1.description: Pelican-1 is the extraction shuttle used to retrieve Helldivers from the battlefield after their mission objectives have been completed. The shuttle arrives at designated extraction zones and transports surviving Helldivers back to their Super Destroyer.

eagle-1.title: Eagle-1
eagle-1.description: Eagle-1 is the pilot responsible for delivering Eagle-based air support to Helldivers on the battlefield. From the Super Destroyer, Eagle-1 conducts rapid attack runs using weapons selected as Stratagems by the Helldiver.

element-710.title: Element 710
element-710.description: Element 710 is a strategically important resource used by Super Earth. Terminids can be processed into Element 710, making the species economically valuable to the Federation despite the enormous threat they pose.

cyberstan.title: Cyberstan
cyberstan.description: Cyberstan is the historic homeworld of the Cyborgs and a major location in the conflict surrounding the Automatons and Super Earth.

democracy-officer.title: Democracy Officer
democracy-officer.description: The Democracy Officer serves aboard the Super Destroyer as a representative of Super Earth authority, providing mission guidance and reinforcing the principles of Managed Democracy.

major-orders.title: Major Orders
major-orders.description: Major Orders are large-scale strategic objectives issued to the Helldiver community. They can require the liberation or defense of planets, destruction of enemy forces, completion of special operations, or other galaxy-wide objectives within a limited period.

first-galactic-war.title: First Galactic War
first-galactic-war.description: The First Galactic War was a roughly forty-year conflict fought by the Super Earth Federation against the Bugs, Cyborgs, and Illuminate. The Helldivers fought across all three fronts, and the war ultimately ended in Super Earth victory. The Bugs were placed into farms for Element 710 production, the defeated Cyborgs were forced to labor on Cyberstan, and the Illuminate were defeated and believed to have been eradicated.

second-galactic-war.title: Second Galactic War
second-galactic-war.description: The Second Galactic War began around 2184 after approximately a century of relative peace following the First Galactic War. Terminids escaped containment and spread through the eastern sectors while the Automaton Legion emerged in the west, prompting Super Earth to reactivate the Helldivers. The conflict later expanded further with the return of the Illuminate, creating a galaxy-wide war fought across multiple fronts.

operation-valiant-enclosure.title: Operation Valiant Enclosure
operation-valiant-enclosure.description: Operation Valiant Enclosure was a major Super Earth campaign against the Terminids during the early Second Galactic War. Helldivers fought to secure the Barrier Planets of Erata Prime, Fenrir III, Meridia, and Turing, where the Terminid Control System was constructed and activated. The TCS dispersed Termicide in an attempt to contain the Terminid threat. Although initially declared a success, some Terminids adapted to the chemical, contributing to explosive reproduction and the eventual transformation of Meridia into a Supercolony.

operation-swift-disassembly.title: Operation Swift Disassembly
operation-swift-disassembly.description: Operation Swift Disassembly was a multi-phase Super Earth offensive intended to completely eradicate the Automatons. Helldivers captured a long-range communications array on Troost, attacked Automaton production centers, defended key worlds against a counterattack, and finally assaulted the remaining Automaton planets of Maia, Tibit, and Durgen. The operation appeared successful when the Automaton vanguard was eliminated, but the victory was short-lived: a much larger Automaton fleet soon invaded during the Reclamation.

the-reclamation.title: The Reclamation
the-reclamation.description: The Reclamation began on April 9, 2184, only two days after Super Earth believed the Automatons had been eradicated. A massive Automaton invasion fleet arrived from beyond the Galactic Frontier and overwhelmed Super Earth defenses across the Valdis region. The invading force dwarfed the Automaton vanguard destroyed during Operation Swift Disassembly and rapidly captured Cyberstan, revealing that the earlier Automaton armies had represented only a fraction of their true strength.
